baseline_pv.description: EfficientNet trained only on PlantVillage; measures the lab-to-field gap.

plantdoc_only.description: EfficientNet trained only on PlantDoc; lower in-domain data volume.

mixed.description: Joint training on controlled and in-the-wild images.

two_stage.description: Stage 1 learns disease semantics on PlantVillage; stage 2 adapts the whole network to natural backgrounds/illumination with a low learning rate.
